verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway ships as a self-hostable product from its public GitHub repo. The repo documents a Docker installation in DB-less mode, hybrid control-plane/data-plane deployment "without any vendor lock-in", and an official Kubernetes Ingress Controller. A self-hosted node exposes the Admin API on :8001 and the Kong Manager UI on :8002, and the repo advertises its AI and MCP gateway features. A community issue report from a user running their own Kong 0.14.1 cluster on Cassandra independently confirms self-hosting in practice. Missing for 10: no explicit statement of the open-source license, and no evidence that Konnect-only layers (Catalog, Dev Portal, the Konnect control plane used by the quickstart) can be self-hosted.
